title: Fix Windows-only test failures so the workspace suite passes on windows-msvc
goal: The wasmtime port made susi build on Windows, but the local gate (cargo nextest --workspace) surfaces roughly a hundred Windows-only test failures: tests that exec .sh scripts through Command directly (os error 193), tests assuming /tmp or unix path semantics, process-group termination expectations, stdout-close semantics, and temp-tree cleanup races on Windows file locking. Fix each cluster at its root (invoke scripts through a POSIX shell on Windows, cfg-gate genuinely unix-only behavior, use taskkill /T where Unix kills process groups, normalize temp-dir handling), keeping behavior identical on unix so the suite is green on both platforms.
